raw_text: The CNSP announces the end of the Bazoum regime. The armed forces of Niger have decided to put an end to the regime that you know due to the deteriorating security situation and bad governance. We call on the population to remain calm. Niger is free. Long live the Republic. All borders are closed until further notice. A curfew is in effect from 22:00 to 06:00.
clean_text: CNSP announces end of Bazoum regime citing security deterioration and bad governance. Calls for calm. Borders closed, curfew imposed 22:00-06:00.
